rca_of_the_issue: Motor 3.x AsyncIOMotorClient lazily binds its internal `_io_loop` and connection-pool topology Future graph to the FIRST event loop it observes. Sync-context helpers in the six Phase-34 test files historically used `asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete()` — solo, this always returns the same still-open default loop; in the full batch, prior tests calling `asyncio.run(...)` create+close ephemeral loops, poisoning Motor's binding. Fix: import-time rebuild of `config.client` on a session-persistent (never-closed) loop via the documented `io_loop=` kwarg, plus a per-test conftest hook that keeps the current-thread default loop pinned to that persistent loop. Verified: solo 127/127, coverage-gate 155/157, +40-test net improvement in the full batch. The ~69 remaining phase34_task batch failures have a DIFFERENT RCA (HTTP ReadTimeout on preview URL from module-scoped super_headers fixtures under load) and are out of scope for 41.1d.
